model_output.rationale: Both lines denied CO-29 (timely filing) with MOA N211. However, the 277CA shows STC*A2:20 with DTP*050 of 2025-01-27 — the claim was accepted 8 days after DOS 2025-01-19, well within any commercial filing limit. Per reference, proof of an accepted submission inside the window → appeal with the clearinghouse acceptance report, disputing the payer's receipt date. 271 confirms active coverage (EB*1, effective 2024-01-01, no termination).

root_cause.explanation: Payer denied CO-29 claiming filing limit expired, but 277CA proves claim accepted 2025-01-27 — 8 days after DOS 2025-01-19. Denial is erroneous; claim was timely.
